_about: Level 1 eval (scripts/eval.py). Labels were written by a person reading the ticket and the profile cached in data/demo.sqlite (Sat 7 Nov), never by the model under test. Scored: `category` (or any of `acceptable_categories`) and the action of options[0] = `expected_action` (or any of `acceptable_actions`), v2 actions from models.ACTIONS. `cases` = the 20 seed tickets; `action` there is the same label in the v1 vocabulary (grant_access / explain / escalate_refund / no_action), kept because tests/test_tickets.py checks it and the category against the generator rule. `old_label` = the v1 action before a relabel, with `note` saying why. v2 rule applied to all 20: an explicit money-back demand goes to a human (refund_to_human; docs/agents.md always_handoff: refund), a vague 'I feel tricked / what can you do' stays grant_access; cancel questions get store_instructions. `hard_cases` = data/feedback_extra.json (import with scripts/import_feedback.py; x-007 needs the email index from scripts/seed_emails.py).

cases.note: relabelled: the cached profile shows lumen.weekly with cancellation_reason=refund, renewal cancelled, premium expired 2026-10-25. The money was already returned and nothing renews; granting access to a refunded user is wrong. The reply explains the refund (the v1 model answered explain, the old label was the miss)
